;Arts and culture
*The [[Eiffel Tower]] in [[Paris]] shuts down after workers go on a [[Strike action|strike]] over ticketing changes. [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2018/08/01/Eiffel-Tower-closed-after-workers-strike-over-ticketing-changes/1901533154462/ (Upi)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Vietnam floods]]
**Two children and a man drown as new floods overflow one bank of the Bui River, engulf several villages, and threaten to submerge parts of [[Hanoi]]. [https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/20180802_04/ (NHK World)]
*An intense heat wave hits [[South Korea]], which started at the end of [[July]] and is forecast to reach its highest temperature in the coming days. The heat wave kills 27 people, while more than 2,200 are taken to the hospital. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/extreme-heatwave-in-south-korea-to-peak-in-coming-days (''The Straits Times'')]
*[[Grenfell Tower fire]]
**[[England]] announces that the [[MHCLG|Ministry of Housing]] will manage [[Grenfell Tower]] in [[London]] once the investigation into the fire that gutted the building and killed 72 people is complete. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-45032803 (BBC)]

;International relations
*[[Turkey–United States relations]], [[2016–present purges in Turkey]]
**The [[White House]] imposes sanctions on two [[Turkish people|Turkish]] officials over the detention of [[Andrew Brunson]], an American pastor who is being tried on espionage and terror-related charges. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/08/sanctions-turkey-officials-detention-pastor-180801180200672.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Law and crime
*An [[globus cruciger|orb]] and two [[crown (headgear)|crowns]], part of the [[Regalia of Sweden]], are stolen from [[Strängnäs Cathedral]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-45028732 (BBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Zimbabwean general election, 2018]]
**Violence breaks out in [[Zimbabwe]] amid allegations of election-rigging by the ruling [[Zanu-PF]] party. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-45035533 (BBC)]
*[[Afghan presidential election, 2019]]
**The [[Afghanistan|Afghan]] government says that it will hold presidential elections on April 20, 2019. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/08/afghanistan-hold-presidential-elections-april-20-2019-180801082206475.html (AL Jazeera)]

;Science and technology
*Researchers from [[Australia]] report the success of a plan to use [[mosquitoes]] infected with ''[[Wolbachia]]'' bacteria to prevent the spread of [[dengue fever]] in an Australian town, stating that they intend to bring the program to other locales. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-45028733 (BBC)]
*[[Reddit]] reports a data breach consisting of emails and usernames. The site states that the perpetrators had access to information on accounts which were subscribed to their newsletter between the 3rd and 17th of June, as well as those created between 2005 and 2007. [https://www.nbcnews.com/tech/tech-news/reddit-announces-data-breach-threatens-anonymity-users-n896686 (NBC)]
